532:t_2:119.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'm sorry, $$宗介$$... It looks like this is the only way...)

532:t_2:127.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So all of this was your doing.」

532:t_2:132.en:
$$桂$$
「You and me...! Even with both $$特異点$$s together, it's still no good!?」

532:t_2:133.en:
$$オルソン$$
「At this rate... a spacetime collapse will occur...!」

532:t_2:134.en:
$$桂$$
「Damn it all!! What good are we as $$特異点$$s!!」

532:t_2:139.en:
$n
「If this... is the power of God...」

532:t_2:145.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$ロロ$$! $$シャーリー$$!」

532:t_2:148.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So you two... still won't forgive me...」

532:t_2:152.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Regret... remorse... despair... death. Is this the future the $$集合無意識$$ shows...」

532:t_2:155.en:
$$シャルル$$
「It has been a long time, $$ルルーシュ$$.」

532:t_2:156.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「You look well, $$ルルーシュ$$.」

532:t_2:157.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「$$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$! And $$マリアンヌ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$ too!」

532:t_2:158.en:
$$シャルル$$
「Your comrades are now trapped in a world beyond time and space, shown to them by the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:159.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「It is the shape of the future, and the image of despair that you yourself felt as well.」

532:t_2:160.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「So we really are heading toward a future of despair!?」

532:t_2:163.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「As if I would ever rely on the likes of you!」

532:t_2:164.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Whatever the future of despair may be, I... we will overcome it!」

532:t_2:165.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「And I will resist! No matter who the opponent is! Even if it's a god!」

532:t_2:166.en:
$$マリアンヌ$$
「Hehe... Can you really do it, I wonder?」

532:t_2:167.en:
$$シャルル$$
「Show me, $$ルルーシュ$$! The way you live, having denied me and $$マリアンヌ$$ and chosen the future!」

532:t_2:168.en:
$$シャルル$$
「And only when you have overcome despair will I acknowledge that you have truly surpassed me!」

532:t_2:172.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ルルーシュ$$...! $$ルルーシュ$$!」

532:t_2:174.en:
$$スザク$$
「We're in front of the door to the ruins.」

532:t_2:175.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I can see that, but why is $$熱気バサラ$$ singing?」

532:t_2:176.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「We'd like to know that ourselves.」

532:t_2:177.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「While we were going through hell, $$バサラ$$ apparently was singing all by himself.」

532:t_2:178.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「He was the only one who wasn't swallowed up by that phenomenon like the $$時空震動|lc$$...」

532:t_2:179.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Even you can't figure out the reason, it seems.」

532:t_2:180.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I can't call it anything but the power of his song...」

532:t_2:181.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, $$バサラ$$! Read the room for once and stop it!」

532:t_2:182.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What are you talking about! We're just getting started!」

532:t_2:183.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is this the time for that!? $$クロウ$$ hasn't come back yet!」

532:t_2:184.en:
$n
「He may have been thrown outside the ruins.」

532:t_2:185.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$ could be somewhere nearby. We're going to find $$クロウ$$.」

532:t_2:186.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Come on, you too, $$バサラ$$!」

532:t_2:188.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! I'm leaving $$ルルーシュ$$ to you!」

532:t_2:190.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That look... It seems you met $$シャルル$$ and $$マリアンヌ$$ too.」

532:t_2:191.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「To think those two... were alive inside the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:192.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Who knows. They may have been the $$シャルル$$ and $$マリアンヌ$$ within you and me, shown by the $$集合無意識$$.」

532:t_2:194.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But in my own way, I have learned what $$シャルル$$ was trying to do.」

532:t_2:195.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「As a successor to the Code, that man also learned of the future of despair, and to avoid it he tried to return to the $$集合無意識$$...」

532:t_2:196.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「He rejected advancing into the future by stopping time, then.」

532:t_2:197.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That was probably his own $$時の牢獄$$.」

532:t_2:198.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I... reject him. That feeling hasn't changed even now.」

532:t_2:199.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Then you have to show that it can be done.」

532:t_2:201.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's right, $$ルルーシュ$$. That is the duty laid upon you.」

532:t_2:202.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...Fine. There's no way I can't do what that man could do!」

532:t_2:203.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「This is different from the escape that man played...! I will face despair and find a way to overcome it!」

532:t_2:210.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can't read his attack motions at all. All I can do is watch with my eyes and react...!」

532:t_2:212.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even at a time like this, it's all about the void for you? It beats killing people for fun, sure, but it's no picnic for the rest of us.」

532:t_2:213.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Sending off lives is our trade.」

532:t_2:215.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$鬼宿$$ is charged with guiding the power born when life scatters in the right direction...」

532:t_2:216.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The power of life, and the power when it scatters...」

532:t_2:217.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The force that seeks to exist and the force that seeks to vanish... is that it?」

532:t_2:218.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Exactly. The $$スフィア$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ is in sync with my power as $$鬼宿$$.」

532:t_2:219.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Death is the loss of the body... That sense of loss cannot be replaced by anything... It is the deepest void.」
